scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('www')) fs.mkdirSync('www'); fs.copyFileSync('index.html', 'www/index.html'); if (fs.existsSync('supabase-config.js')) { fs.copyFileSync('supabase-config.js', 'www/supabase-config.js'); } else if (fs.existsSync('supabase-config.sample.js')) { fs.copyFileSync('supabase-config.sample.js', 'www/supabase-config.js'); } console.log('Web assets prepared in www/');"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
